name: @qu/qr
description: Browser-only QR code encode (render a string as a QR code into a container) and decode (read a QR code from a live camera stream) helpers - the device-to-device identity transfer mechanism apps/profile's backup section and apps/shell's onboarding screen both use. Thin wrappers around audited third-party libraries (qrcode/jsqr) rather than a hand-rolled encoder/decoder, same reasoning @qu/identity's bip39.js gives for not hand-rolling BIP-39: QR's Reed-Solomon error correction and format/mask-pattern bit-packing is exactly the kind of thing that's easy to get subtly wrong.
